steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(21); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setWalkEyeHeight?.(1.2)

steps.name: assert-flags-on-simple
steps.failMessage: walkScreens/walkLights should both be ON in default Simple mode (simple tier, default true)

steps.name: assert-orbit-inert-screen

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-b2-monitor'); return it && (it.props.screenContent ?? 'landscape') === 'landscape' })()

steps.failMessage: Pressing E in ORBIT mode must NOT cycle the monitor's wallpaper (walk-only interact gate)

steps.name: assert-orbit-inert-light

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-b2-pendant'); return it && it.props.lightOn !== 'no' })()

steps.failMessage: Pressing E in ORBIT mode must NOT toggle the pendant light (walk-only interact gate)

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: aim-loop-detects-monitor
steps.failMessage: FirstPersonCamera's real aim loop should set nearbyScreenId to the bedroom-2 desk monitor

steps.name: screen-content-cycled

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-b2-monitor'); return it && it.props.screenContent === 'sunset' })()

steps.failMessage: The real E-key handler should advance the aimed monitor's screenContent to 'sunset'

steps.name: aim-loop-detects-pendant
steps.failMessage: FirstPersonCamera's real aim loop should set nearbyLightId to the bedroom-2 ceiling pendant

steps.name: prompt-says-turn-off
steps.failMessage: LightPrompt should read 'Turn off ceiling light' while it is lit

steps.name: light-toggled-off

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-b2-pendant'); return it && it.props.lightOn === 'no' })()

steps.failMessage: The real E-key handler should flip the aimed pendant's lightOn to 'no'

steps.name: prompt-says-turn-on
steps.failMessage: LightPrompt should flip to 'Turn on ceiling light' once off

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i => i.id === 'default-b2-pendant'); return it && it.props.lightOn === 'yes' })()
